**Host-Guard & CI Hygiene**
#1530 fixed the host-guard selector to correctly measure against the full-suite target, preventing inert fixes for heavyweight shapes. #1922 parallelized the detect-secrets-hook using xargs to reduce CI time. #1778 revived the sealed OMN-17732 bundle, adding strict backend and permission security leaf configs.

**Delegation & Runtime**
#1817 added a terminal cause for delegations cut off by runtime shutdowns. #3719 enabled merge-sweep plan compute to run from the runtime tick. #3530 distinguished backend UUIDs for shared model IDs to prevent collisions. #3494 added tests for receipt identity after rerouting.

**OCC & Evidence Gates**
#1820 exempted the OCC writer app from evidence gates only when pin-only is proven. #3578 pinned the reusable workflow that derives this exemption. #3349 restricted hand-authored OCC defers to only the PRs named by the open companion. #1219 added a receipt-honesty validator to fail gamed DoD receipts.

**Provider & Model Integration**
#3800 added a Claude review gateway with a voter endpoint per lab host. #3437 refused leading reasoning traces at the quality floor. #3561 pinned the omnidash v1.1.5 bundle for the onex dashboard.

**CI & Workflow Infrastructure**
#3233 integrated the enforcing delegation-health check into omnimarket. #3153 fixed the release-cut main sync to accept 40-character commit SHAs. #1703 pushed release tags with the App token to trigger release workflows. #3529 hosted the hardcoded-model-config reusable workflow in omnimarket. #369 enabled omnibase_spi to produce the deployment-config hygiene context.

**Code Quality & Documentation**
#1413 scoped mypy ignore_missing_imports per-module to stop masking unresolvable imports. #1093 introduced configurable aislop validators with per-repo YAML overrides. #985 defined ONEX on first use and added the contract YAML for the receipt gate.

**Testing & Contracts**
#3701 bound the queued-PR clause of AC3 to a live readback of the merge queue. #2987 fixed the companion heal's missing-stamp outcome to exclude drafts and autobind declines. #3530 bound the DR-16 backend identity test in the ticket contract.

**Dependency & Version Management**
#1813 bumped the actions group with 7 updates. #2937 declared session_content ownership to allow omnibase_infra to vendor the migration.
